brief: Round a monetary calculation at the specified step and explain the remaining difference.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Round at the right step"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Redondea en el paso correcto"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Arredonde na etapa certa"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Round a monetary calculation at the specified step and explain the remaining difference.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Small rounding differences still need an explanation.
instruction.misconception: Round each intermediate number when the stated rule requires rounding the final total.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: Split 10 three ways: 3.33 each totals 9.99. One cent remains; agree who covers it instead of pretending it vanished.
Keep two decimals. Look at the third digit: five or more adds one cent; below five leaves the cents unchanged.
A following digit of five or more rounds upward.
A following digit below five leaves the retained digit unchanged.
Rounding belongs at the step named by the rule.
Rounded contributions leave a visible one-cent gap.
Rounding can carry into the whole-unit place.
Different rounding steps can explain a small discrepancy.

en-US.line: Small rounding differences still need an explanation.

en-US.line: Split 10 three ways: 3.33 each totals 9.99. One cent remains; agree who covers it instead of pretending it vanished.

es-MX.line: Reparte 10 entre tres: 3.33 cada uno suma 9.99. Queda un centavo; acuerden quién lo cubre en vez de ignorarlo.

pt-BR.line: Divida 10 entre três: 3,33 cada soma 9,99. Resta um centavo; combinem quem o cobre em vez de ignorá-lo.

en-US.line: Keep two decimals. Look at the third digit: five or more adds one cent; below five leaves the cents unchanged.

es-MX.line: Conserva dos decimales. Mira el tercer dígito: cinco o más suma un centavo; menos de cinco deja los centavos iguales.

pt-BR.line: Mantenha duas casas decimais. Veja o terceiro dígito: cinco ou mais soma um centavo; abaixo de cinco mantém os centavos.

en-US.scene: Round 4.236 to two decimal places. The third digit is six.
help: Keep two decimal places and inspect the next digit.

feedback.met: A following digit of five or more rounds upward.
feedback.not_yet: Keep two decimal places and inspect the next digit.
